items: 1. Explicitly reopened onboarding Screen3 remaining a permission editor is user-ratified as non-conflicting and requires no product change; Dashboard itself remains forbidden from permission editing.
2. RETAINED DEFECT: changing Tunnel ID or Runtime API Key while asynchronous runtime startup is Starting/connecting can bypass controlled reconnect and continue with captured old configuration.
3. CONTRACT: one-shot notices such as 无法准备管理员权限 must be temporary, default 3 seconds, rather than permanent page content; persistent runtime faults remain typed persistent state.

4. SUPERSEDED_BY_ROUND2: the earlier polling-independent timing-only display contract was strengthened to backend wake-driven delivery, minimum 500ms UI visibility without response delay, and a separate last-tool row with right-aligned age.

5. VERIFIED DEFECT/CONTRACT: Windows GetFinalPathNameByHandleW may return a verbatim resolved identity path such as \\?\D:\project. Current code can propagate that value through WorkspaceRef/runtime config into MCP/process current_dir and tool cwd/workdir, which can make command execution fail. Verbatim form is identity-validation-only; UI and every MCP/Broker/sidecar/process/command/tool execution path must use ordinary D:\project tied to the same validated filesystem identity, and conversion must never widen authorization.

6. CONTRACT: peer buttons share a horizontal action column; at 780x620 the two Settings 更换 actions remain in the same rightmost column and the Runtime API Key 清除 action sits immediately to the left without shifting that column.

7. CONTRACT: Dashboard adds real 重启服务 amber and 关闭服务 red buttons, aligned with the shared button system; backend owns controlled single-owner restart and orderly manual-stop lifecycle, with no second design language and no restart-triggered UAC.
